const.timing_support_inputs: Idle boundary in proposal's originating turn; parties/terms/eligibility revalidated under §2.15; acceptor is action actor
const.allowance_declaration_cost: No proposal reservation or opening cost; supplying an Ace consumes its supplier's shared round use only at legal acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Revalidate and commit every transfer/alliance together after responses; cancellation/failure transfers nothing and creates no alliance; committed Ace allowance stays consumed.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own idle; integer quantity and unrestricted own number Spades under §2.16
const.allowance_declaration_cost: No card payment at acceptance; no separate purchase quota
const.resolution_cancellation: Revalidate exact price/payment/full supply, then return/shuffle/draw atomically; cancel or invalid resolution: keep payment and draw nothing.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; exposed Clubs; choose legal target and unused Club subset
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Physical Clubs used at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Apply attack result/exchange; cancel retains used Clubs on table.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own opening/reconfiguration; defensive combo; fixed pair and replacement slot
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Opening allowance; no activation quota
const.resolution_cancellation: None; §2.11 binding rules apply even if substitution stops.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; offensive combo; eligible opponent
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Turn-cycle; no card payment at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Return one chosen Fate king immediately before the reset shuffle, then reset target cards atomically; cancel: keep.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; offensive combo; legal club attack
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Round; original Clubs used at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: No consumable Baron card cost; cancel retains round use and Club usage. Bomb exception below.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own opening or successfully resolved valid combo loan; formation allocation
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Opening rule/loan transfer; passive thereafter
const.resolution_cancellation: No consumed cards; privilege and formation income separated in §3.2.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own opening/reconfiguration; defensive combo; one public target
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Opening/reconfiguration allowance
const.resolution_cancellation: Passive while formation/support valid; no activation cost or defensive-use quota.

const.timing_support_inputs: Any time including pending-input boundaries; historical Clubs, four real queens, unallied
const.allowance_declaration_cost: No quota or consumable cost; cannot respond
const.resolution_cancellation: Atomic board closure and Coup accounting; never a half-effect interruption.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; offensive combo; eligible opponents in fixed seat order
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Turn-cycle; no card payment at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Return one chosen Justice queen after its selection sequence resolves, including zero captures; cancel before resolution: keep.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; non-attacking global declaration; offensive combo support with Underground waiver; select legal settings
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Turn-cycle; no card cost
const.resolution_cancellation: Replace governing declaration/settings; cancel leaves old Code governing. Penalty is passive from the functioning declarer's formation, requires the declarer not confined and two current series, and excludes departed/initially protected/confined opponents at round end.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; offensive combo; eligible opponent
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Once per own turn; no card cost at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Normal theft has no combo cost. Special Doppelganger theft returns every physical card allocated to the Kidnapper formation and moves both stolen kings with debt settlement; cancel: keep. Returned substitute kings retain their own binding.

const.timing_support_inputs: Any idle; offensive combo; eligible target
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Turn-cycle; no card cost at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Return all four jacks after legal resolution, including zero stolen; cancel: keep jacks, retain used quota.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; king attached to any own number-supported series
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Game; no card payment at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Discard king and award 10 together; cancel: keep.

const.timing_support_inputs: Round end; non-diamond king, exactly one king attached to that supported series
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Passive; one award per eligible physical king
const.resolution_cancellation: No cost; no income if support invalid at award boundary.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; same supporting-series conditions
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Round; no card payment at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Discard king, draw up to two under supply rule; cancel: keep.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own attack declaration; queen attached to own supported Clubs; attack facing Barricade
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Round at accepted bypass; Clubs used normally
const.resolution_cancellation: No card cost; bypass is committed with declaration and round use remains if attack canceled.

const.timing_support_inputs: When own Hearts attacked; queen attached to own supported Hearts
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Passive
const.resolution_cancellation: Successful elimination exchanges attacking Clubs under balance unless applicable exception; canceled attack has no exchange.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; same support; queen plus five other controlled cards
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Turn-cycle; no card payment at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Discard queen, return five selected cards, draw up to five; mark each resulting physical card restricted until next round under §2.14. Cancel: keep all selected cards.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own attack declaration; jack attached to supported Clubs; non-Diamond bypass target
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Turn-cycle; return jack upon accepted bypass declaration
const.resolution_cancellation: Its bypass and jack return are already committed; spent even if later attack is canceled.

const.timing_support_inputs: Response to incoming club attack; jack attached to supported Spades; selections in §2.10
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Round on legal activation; no positive-common-match means illegal, no quota
const.resolution_cancellation: Atomically mark newly added Clubs used, transfer selected Spades to attacker, return jack, cancel attack after final decision. Original Club use stands throughout. Abort before commit: no added usage/payment/card return; accepted quota stays used.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own; jack attached to supported Diamonds, prepayment total ≥20; exposed legal enemy royal
const.allowance_declaration_cost: One shared round use with prevention
const.resolution_cancellation: Return one selected own number Diamond and discard target together; cancel: keep Diamond and royal.

const.timing_support_inputs: Inside hostile ace resolution targeting controller; same attachment, prepayment total 1–10; choose prevention/pass and payable Diamond
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Same shared round use; accept only a legal payable choice
const.resolution_cancellation: Return chosen Diamond and prevent ace effect atomically; hostile ace's consumed quota stands and its ace is discarded. Not available for Coup.

const.timing_support_inputs: Bomb attached to own supported series; enemy must attack Bomb first with effective Club total ≥5; Baron uses its exception
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Passive; attacker commits Club usage / Baron round use
const.resolution_cancellation: Ordinary successful destruction: return attacking physical Clubs, discard Bomb, mark protected series immune to club attacks for rest of round. Baron discards Bomb with no Club-return cost. Cancellation: no destruction/removal. Kidnapping/assassination does not trigger the destruction shield.

const.timing_support_inputs: Response to a pending action; target its actor (self/third-party defense permitted); ace prerequisites
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Shared one-ace-per-round at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Discard ace when resolution finishes, including Dexter prevention; otherwise cancel pending action/apply confinement atomically.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own attack declaration for +10 Clubs; response to incoming attack for +10 Hearts
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Shared ace quota at accepted use; modifier committed
const.resolution_cancellation: Reveal/discard ace after combat resolves or is canceled; spent if canceled. Dexter prevention removes its modifier, not usage/discard.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own main action against an eligible opponent, or response to an attack on controller targeting that attacker only; ace prerequisites
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Shared ace quota; duplicate active target is illegal and costs nothing
const.resolution_cancellation: On resolution move ace into the public active-effect zone/apply effect; Dexter prevention discards ace without effect. Cancellation before resolution retains ace but quota consumed.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own main action or response to an attack on controller before its losses; ace prerequisites
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Shared ace quota plus game activation at acceptance
const.resolution_cancellation: Move ace into the public active-effect zone/create counter on resolution; cancellation keeps ace but consumed allowances stand. Persist remainder; deferred draws use only qualifying later losses.

const.timing_support_inputs: Own attack declaration or incoming-combat response; declare 2–10, face hidden
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Shared ace quota at acceptance; combat value committed
const.resolution_cancellation: Reveal/discard after combat resolves or is canceled; cannot also use named power.

const.timing_support_inputs: Accepted legal player-to-player transaction under §2.15; never deck-purchase currency
const.allowance_declaration_cost: Shared one-ace-per-round of the player supplying the ace
const.resolution_cancellation: Complete transaction once; failed/canceled accepted transaction retains quota but no transfer. Recipient's quota is unaffected until they use/transfer it.
